title: feat(nm2frm2lx3): L-path cyclic-frame transport -e3 then -e1 at t+1 on three-axis opposite near-face seed: reverse HOLD, face fails
science: Bare L-path (-e3,-e1) on the near-face seed. Together with #7672 this isolates the direction-selectivity of the third seed pair: -e1 survives it, +e1 does not.
